items.summary: In recent tests, Lockheed Martin’s Skunk Works, the U.S. Air Force Test Pilot School and partners used an AI agent on the X-62 VISTA to autonomously execute 27 live air intercepts using real-time sensor data. items.summary: Lockheed Martin (NYSE:LMT) has partnered with space infrastructure company Gravitics on a Department of War contract focused on orbital systems with national importance. The company has also signed a memorandum of understanding with NioCorp to work toward a scandium oxide supply agreement that would support a U.S. scandium to warfighter supply chain.
